question: What higher attainment follows from chanting this mantra six hundred thousand times?
premises: This same mantra is chanted six hundred thousand times.
Increased repetition yields a higher attainment.
The attained state is lordship over vidyādharas.
inference: Chanting this mantra six hundred thousand times makes one a great lord of vidyādharas.
plain_english: By chanting this mantra six hundred thousand times, one becomes a great lord of the vidyādharas.
